facts.fact: Kiamling 在坟地等到香烧成红尖、灰烬像蛇蜕，祖母 Por Por 仍未回来；她往火里又扔了一把纸钱
facts.anchor: The dozens of joss sticks had already burnt to red spikes, ash like ribbons of shed snakeskin, and still Por Por had not returned

facts.fact: 在广州本会先择吉日办仪式、备供品数日，此地只有一夜可用
facts.anchor: Back in Canton, an auspicious date would have been chosen for the ceremony

facts.fact: Por Por 一开口就点出 Kiamling 漏买了菠萝，对已备好的鸡、芒果、荔枝不作评
Kiamling 正式学徒已五年，随家人自广州南迁香港，皮肤晒成田间劳作的棕色
facts.anchor: It had been five years since her apprenticeship had started in earnest

facts.fact: Por Por 摇手铃，铃声在夜里回荡；华人回避这片贴了黄符的地，英国人起初当看戏
facts.anchor: Por Por rang a handbell, the sound echoing across the darkness of night

facts.fact: Por Por 逐坟跪诵咒语，泥土散开，尸体在坟中直挺挺立起
facts.anchor: Loose dirt scattered under her steadying hand, and the corpses stood up in their graves

facts.fact: Kiamling 运一口真气跃过一排排尸体，给每具额头贴上符纸，指尖触到的尸肤冰凉
facts.anchor: She bounded across the rows of the dead, fastening a fu talisman to each forehead

facts.fact: 尸骨要迁到远离港区心脏的新坟；村民抗议说祖先之灵会迷路变成无人祭的饿鬼，英方不让步
facts.anchor: The corpses’ new home was far from the growing heart of the harbour

facts.fact: 队伍走到欧人区边上出事：晴空一道闪电，有东西撞进整齐的跳尸队列
facts.anchor: something barrelled into the orderly line of hopping corpses

facts.fact: 一名烂醉的英军军官边喊英文边追女人，抓住的却是尸体的青绿脖颈；那女人掩口笑，行礼后溜回暗处
facts.anchor: The man’s intentions were as clear as his yelled English

facts.fact: 那只狐狸精（wulei jing）故意把军官引进赶尸队列，Kiamling 觉得背后有线头可拉
facts.anchor: this one had led a merry chase deliberately into their column

facts.fact: 醉军官扯下尸体脸上的符去亲它，符纸落地；女尸眼珠转成墨黑，化成殭尸 geongsi 咬向 Kiamling
facts.anchor: he ripped the fu talisman off the corpse’s face to kiss it

facts.fact: 剩下的三只殭尸围上来，军官抓她肩膀把她当盾牌推向前，喊「她更年轻」
facts.anchor: She could not shake the drunken coward off, but she dared not turn her attention to him either

facts.fact: Por Por 用手杖敲倒最后一只殭尸，并重新贴上符纸，冷冷问 Kiamling 是不是打算在那儿蹲一夜
facts.anchor: Por Por’s staff smacked into the side of the geongsi’s head

facts.fact: Por Por 说「有人死时带着怒气」——怨气未必能被丧仪化掉，会把寻常尸体慢慢养成殭尸
Kiamling 向军官开账单：驱邪、毁坏财物、洗衣费；军官脸色涨红后当场呕吐
facts.anchor: Who shall we make the bill out to

facts.fact: 两具尸体被 Kiamling 打得收不回来，她得再跑一趟、借车把残骸运回
facts.anchor: Two corpses could not be recovered, the two Kiamling had all but obliterated during the fight

facts.fact: 对 Kiamling 而言这只是又一天：肾上腺素、尸气与侥幸活下来的松弛，明早军官会当成酒后的梦
facts.anchor: For Kiamling, it was just another day
